name: Earth Climate & Terrestrial Observer
goal: Monitor global vegetation health, land-use dynamics, and atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations.
description: Deploy an advanced Earth-observing satellite into polar Sun-Synchronous Orbit (SSO) to conduct high-resolution multispectral imaging and atmospheric lidar soundings.
objective: Deliver uninterrupted multispectral land and cloud imagery across repeat orbits to support global climate and agriculture monitoring.
scienceObjectives: Global Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) mapping
Atmospheric aerosol and greenhouse gas column profiling

name: Lunar Polar Prospector & Water Ice Explorer
goal: Map volatile water ice deposits in permanently shadowed polar craters and quantify the lunar gravitational field.
description: Place a robotic research probe into a 100 km polar orbit around the Moon to map surface minerals, measure neutron flux signatures of water ice, and assess Artemis landing sites.
objective: Identify high-confidence hydrogen concentrations in permanently shadowed regions of the lunar south pole and generate high-precision topographical maps.
scienceObjectives: Epithermal neutron detection of subsurface hydrogen deposits (>100 ppm)
Sub-meter polar crater topography and geodetic altimetry
Thermal infrared radiometric mapping of cryogenic cold traps

name: Mars Atmospheric Evolution & Climate Surveyor
goal: Quantify atmospheric escape mechanisms, solar wind interaction, and seasonal subsurface water ice reservoirs.
description: Execute interplanetary cruise to Mars, perform Mars Orbit Insertion (MOI) into a 300 km science orbit, and examine the Martian ionosphere and shallow subsurface ice layers.
objective: Measure the modern rate of atmospheric escape caused by solar wind stripping and sound polar subsurface ice sheets to 100 meters depth.
scienceObjectives: Solar wind magnetic interaction and upper atmosphere ion loss rate measurement
Shallow subsurface ice sheet detection via radar sounding
Atmospheric infrared and ultraviolet trace gas seasonal monitoring
